title: More Moons
description: adds more Moons to light up the night sky!
body:
minecraft's moon is boring... no it's not? well... ## Intro This resource pack changes the Moon Phases to be other Moons (or planets) instead! :O
All moons are ~~taken from~~ INSPIRED... by terraria of course... :P
Because this pack uses the moon's phases to display different planets, every night a new moon appears on the night sky! :D
it also means that it is not compatible with other packs that change the moon's phases... whoops!
FaQ some questions o_O **Q: Can I use this pack with other packs that change the moon's phases? :D** A: No, since the planets depend on the moon's phases to display. :( **Q: Can I use this pack with a pack that changes the sun? :D** A: Yes, as this one only changes the moon! **Q: Will there ever be any compatibility with packs like cubic sun & moon and ect.? :D** A: Probably not, as I must first get permission from the creators of these packs, as well as actually know how to make ones in that style. :/ **Q: Will this pack get backwards compatibility for earlier versions of minecraft? :D** A: Maybe? I am not fammiliar with versions bellow 1.19 as that was the version I started making packs for, so maybe if one day I want to give my stuff backward compatibility, I will do. :)
Thank You for checking it out it means a lot!!! ^3^
